resources.string: Wisp: Private Browser
Wisp
Please allow Wisp to install apps from \"Unknown sources\" in system settings

Now you can browse privately, and other people who use this device won’t see your activity. Wisp won’t save your browsing history, cookies and site data, information entered in forms.\n\nHowever, downloads and bookmarks will be saved. Your activity might still be visible to websites you visit, your organization or internet service provider.
Wisp is the phone version of Lumen, a modified version of TV Bro, and uses TV Bro\'s sources by Fedir Tsapana: https://github.com/truefedex/tv-bro

Your builds are in a private repository, so Wisp needs a read-only token to see them: on github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Fine-grained tokens → Generate, choose only this repository, and give it \"Contents: Read-only\". The token is stored encrypted on this device. Leave the field empty to keep the saved token.
